text:
sam-peopleops: Heads-up  Omar R starts 7/12 remote. BG vendor flagged an SSN/name mismatch; they asked for "SSN verification" (SSA letter or recent paystub) before final clearance. Passport and driver's license are OK. Need a quick ops decision on laptop shipping and I-9 path.

leah-recruiter: Can you DM me the vendor note? Omar said he used his previous employer's payroll last year, so he might have a paystub. He prefers device shipped to his apartment and wants to do orientation in Pacific mornings.

sam-peopleops: DM'd vendor note. Vendor text: "Name/SSN mismatch - please provide SSA document (SSA-LTR) or employer paystub dated within 12 months." Link to secure upload: https://redwood-secure.upload/newhire.

bg-check-bot: BG CHECK UPDATE: Omar R 1977777800 status: manual review. Requested docs sent 1977778000.

leah-recruiter: I'll message Omar and ask him to upload either a paystub or an SSA letter. Also ask whether he can visit an authorized agent for I-9 if needed.

it-ops: Shipping policy refresher: default is ship T+1 unless background unresolved or identity docs missing. For flagged cases we put "HOLD-SEC" and require signature + photo ID on delivery. We can also set up concierge pickup at 9am on his start date if he can come by. If candidate uploads SSA doc before 3pm PT we can release same-day.

sam-peopleops: Quick policy note: for remote hires we can proceed with I-9 via authorized agent OR use remote exception if ID provided within 3 business days. SSN verification is a BG/tax clearance issue and doesn't block I-9 itself. But hiring manager wants device day-1 so need to decide.

leah-recruiter: Omar just replied: "I can upload a recent paystub tonight and would prefer the laptop shipped. If anything else is needed I can pick up at concierge on Day 1."

newhire-omar: hi all 1977777950 just uploaded a redacted paystub and a selfie with my driver's license to the secure link. let me know if you need more. prefer shipping to apt but happy to pick up if easier. thanks!

bg-check-bot: Docs received 1977778005. Manual reviewer notes: paystub OK, reviewer awaiting SSN trace confirmation. Assigned 1977778020.

it-ops: Received note. We'll tentatively prepare shipment but hold at the carrier with code "HOLD-SEC" until final clearance. Courier instruction: require recipient photo ID and signature, add note "release after BG confirmation". If People Ops approves release earlier we can change the hold.

sam-peopleops: Action plan: 1) People Ops will wait for BG final confirmation (expected within 24h), 2) IT prepares device and marks package HOLD-SEC, 3) Recruiter confirms Omar timezone for orientation (Pacific mornings). If BG clears before cutoff we'll ship same-day; otherwise concierge pickup on Day 1. I'll post status update here.

leah-recruiter: Confirmed orientation at 9am PT for Day 1. I'll tell OMAR to expect either shipment tracking or pickup instructions by EOD.

bg-check-bot: Final review complete 1977778550. Status: cleared (SSN trace matched to paystub).

it-ops: BG cleared  releasing shipment now. Carrier tracking: https://dhl.example/track/ABC123456789. Marking package as signature required.

sam-peopleops: Great. Closing loop: I updated Workday with BG clearance note and I-9 plan (remote exception documented; candidate will provide ID within 3 days). Welcome Omar! :wave:
